merges.resolution_basis: Control Center authorization for UNLV Stage 1: VEN-000965 (liu-meadowlands-arena, Meadowlands Arena (Brendan Byrne Arena), East Rutherford, NJ) is a duplicate physical identity of VEN-000028 (brendan-byrne-arena, Brendan Byrne Arena, East Rutherford, NJ). Retain VEN-000028 as survivor, retire VEN-000965, and preserve accepted historical names, aliases, and evidence.
